item.title: Arbitral Award Cannot Be Set Aside Merely Because Another View Is Possible: Supreme Court
item.description: The Supreme Court held that an arbitral award cannot be interfered with under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 merely because a different view is possible on the evidence.
item.tags: Justice B.V. Nagarathna, Justice Satish Chandra Sharma, ABC Infra Ltd., Union of India
item.dc:creator: Ritu Yadav
